tasks.title: Wire into run loop
tasks.description:
TDD. Integrate post-task review into `src/commands/run.ts`.

1. **Add deps to RunRunDeps** (around line 272): Add `captureGitSha: (projectRoot: string) => string | null` and `runPostTaskReview: (opts: RunPostTaskReviewOpts) => Promise<void>`. Import the types and default implementations from `src/post-task-reviewer.ts`.

2. **Capture SHA before agent spawn** (~line 533, before `deps.spawnClaude()`): `const beforeSha = deps.captureGitSha(projectRoot);`

3. **Call review after test validation** (~line 563, after validateTaskTests, before archiveCompletedTasks ~line 565): Re-read the task from tasks.json to get its current status. If status is 'complete', call:
```ts
await deps.runPostTaskReview({
  projectRoot,
  dataDir,
  task: currentTask,
  taskStatus: updatedTask.status,
  beforeSha,
  config,
  streamOpts,
});
```

4. **Set defaults in createDefaultDeps()**: Import `captureGitSha` and `runPostTaskReview` from post-task-reviewer and wire them as defaults.

Tests in `test/commands/run.test.ts`:
- SHA is captured before spawnClaude is called
- runPostTaskReview is called after validation when task is complete
- runPostTaskReview is NOT called when review.postTask is false/undefined
- runPostTaskReview is NOT called when task status is not complete
tasks.notes: Wired post-task review into run loop: added captureGitSha and runPostTaskReview to RunRunDeps with defaults from post-task-reviewer.ts. SHA captured before spawnClaude, review called after validateTaskTests only when config.review.postTask is true AND re-read task status is 'complete'. 4 new integration tests cover: SHA ordering, review called on complete, review skipped when config disabled, review skipped when task not complete. All 732 tests pass.
